change_notes: Initial Chunk 3 synthetic evaluation fixture set with one text-only scenario per workload.
Covers research, coding, and recommendation prompts without requiring live oMLX access.
Expanded the prompt-case catalog to include MTP-on profile variants so prompt-quality comparisons can track both sides of the benchmark matrix.
Added the missing short-code-research MTP-on case so every benchmarked workload now has explicit evaluation coverage for both profile variants where defined.
